purpose: Vertical slice validating the grammar skill-tree IA (Foundations line + one goal branch) before the tree UI.

anchors.meaning: the て-form of verbs/adjectives: the connective form used for linking, requests, and aspect
anchors.review_reason: foundation form (non-catalog anchor *te-form now realized as a node)

anchors.meaning: the plain past (た) form of verbs and adjectives; the base for たら, たり, and clauses like 〜たことがある
anchors.review_reason: foundation form (non-catalog anchor *ta-form now realized as a node)

anchors.meaning: the plain negative (ない) form of verbs; the base for なかった, なくて, ないで and many negative patterns
anchors.review_reason: foundation form (non-catalog anchor *nai-form now realized as a node)

anchors.meaning: the provisional conditional (〜ば) form: 'if/when ~', built from the e-row stem plus ば
anchors.review_reason: foundation form (non-catalog anchor *ba-conditional now realized as a node)

anchors.meaning: the volitional (〜よう/おう) form: 'let's ~ / I'll ~ / shall we ~'; the base for ようとする and ようとおもう

anchors.meaning: the causative (〜せる/させる) form: 'make/let someone do'; the base for the causative-passive and for 〜させてください

foundations.name: Foundations
foundations.description: The mandatory near-linear spine every goal route shares — copula, core particles, verb bases, the て-form/aspect cluster, desire, conditionals, connectives, nominalizers and comparison.

nodes.meaning: plain non-past copula 'is / are' (asserts identity or state)
nodes.review_reason: core copula (past form = datta)

nodes.meaning: polite copula 'is / are' (です・ます style)
particle は marking the topic/theme (as for ~)
particle の: possessive/linking (A の B = B of A) and nominalizer (clause → noun)
nodes.senses: [{"label": "possessive", "canonical": "〜の〜", "meaning": "possessive/linking: A の B = B of A"}, {"label": "nominalizer", "canonical": "〜の", "meaning": "nominalizes a clause (= こと)"}]

nodes.meaning: is not ~ (casual negative copula); also tag 'right?'
past-tense plain copula 'was / were'

nodes.meaning: particle が marking the grammatical subject

nodes.meaning: particle へ marking direction/goal of movement (toward)
nodes.review_reason: lone 'e' (short_term) but [direction] gloss pins particle へ

nodes.meaning: particle と: 'and' (exhaustive listing of nouns); 'with' (accompaniment)

nodes.review_reason: addition も; 'even' sense is mo²

nodes.meaning: particle から marking a starting point: from (place/time)
until; as far as; up to; (emphatic) even

nodes.meaning: particle か: question marker; embedded question / uncertainty (〜かどうか)

nodes.meaning: sentence-final particle seeking agreement/confirmation; softens a statement

be ~ing (progressive); resultant ongoing state

nodes.meaning: want to (do) — V-stem + たい

nodes.meaning: conditional と: whenever/if X, (then the natural/automatic result)

findings: LAYOUT: prereq-depth (decision #6) collapses to <=2 tiers across the whole slice — the enriched candidate_prereqs mostly point at *-form anchors, not at each other, so depth cannot order the spine. The curated STAGE (decision #9) is therefore the real vertical axis; prereq depth stays a secondary within-stage signal + edge source.

ANCHORS: the 8 form anchors (te-form, masu-stem, ta-form, nai-form, ba-conditional, volitional-form, causative-form, counter) — referenced as prereqs ~225x — are now PROMOTED to real catalog rows + teaching pages (Build step 1); their `*` prereq refs were flipped to bare slugs.

DEDUP: many surfaces carry several catalog slugs (て/te-2 OCR dup; が subject / が 'but' and を object/path/separation genuine sense-splits). The two are not mechanically separable, so a same-surface review pass is needed before the full tree ships; the curation picked one slug per rung.
BRANCH: a register-set filter ('literary'∈register) cleanly selects a 145-node subway line; a 22-node curated route through it is coherent and attaches to Foundations with zero ordering violations.
